August 21, 1939.
Afternoon Translation

Chinese-American Daily News:-

"AN OPEN LETTER TO SCHOOL-MATES" FROM THE THREE THOUSAND
STUDENTS OF THE SHANGHAI MIDDLE SCHOOL

This paper yesterday received the
following letter purporting to come from the "three
thousand students" of the privately established Shanghai
Middle School who are unwilling to be slaves:-
"School-mates who do not want to be
slaves should understand that we are opposed to surrender,
but Chen Chi-zung (陳濟成), the principal, has surrendered.
This is not only bad for the students of the Shanghai
Middle School but it is humiliating to educational circles
and youths circles throughout the whole country.
"In June this year, Chen Chi-zung, on
the recommendation of Chow Vai-hai, became a member of the
puppet Educational Committee. In addition to the $600 he
receives monthly from Chow Vai-hai, he is also in receipt
of $4,000 as a students' subsidy. He is a delegate to
the meeting of puppet delegates, a member of the puppet
Central Committee and Senior Advisor to the Hwa Shing Bank.
Since his appointment as member of the Educational
Committee, he has been endeavouring to induce his friends
to co-operate with him in order to please Chow Vai-hai.
At one time when things were against Chow Vai-hai, he
ordered Chen Chi-zung to issue a circular telegram
supporting the peace movement. Chen Chi-zung did as
requested.
"When he perceived the changed situation
after issuing the circular and signs of unsteadiness in the
entire school, Chen begged for help from Chow Vai-hai who
allowed him to publish an irrelevant notice in the papers
and also to use slogans supporting the war of resistance
to deceive the students. Then he inserted advertisements
in newspapers and gave instructions to us students.
"Why does not Chen Chi-zung oppose the
peace movement both in his advertisements and in his
instructions to us students? Is it not because he wanted
to cover his secret behavior?
"We should be model fighters in the war
of resistance and national reconstruction otherwise youths
circles would regard us as pro-puppet elements and the
Bureau of Education will not recognise our qualifications.
"The three thousand students of the
privately established Shanghai
Middle School who are unwilling
to be slaves."
page_data.zh:
1939年8月21日。
下午译文

《中美日报》：

上海中学三千学生《致同学公开信》

本报昨日收到一封声称来自不愿做奴隶的私立上海中学“三千名学生”的来信：
“不愿做奴隶的同学们应当明白，我们反对投降，但校长陈济成（Chen Chi-zung）已经投降。这不仅对上海中学的学生不利，也是对全国教育界和青年界的侮辱。
“今年六月，陈济成经周佛海推荐，成为傀儡教育委员会成员。除了每月从周佛海处领取的600元外，他还收取4,000元作为学生补贴。他是傀儡代表会议的代表，傀儡中央委员会委员，以及华兴银行的高级顾问。自从被任命为教育委员会成员以来，他一直努力诱导朋友与他合作，以取悦周佛海。有一次，当周佛海处境不利时，他命令陈济成发布一份支持和平运动的循环电报。陈济成照办了。
“当他发出通电后察觉到局势变化以及全校出现不稳迹象时，陈向周佛海求助，周允许他在报纸上发表无关紧要的通知，并使用支持抗战的口号来欺骗学生。随后他在报纸上刊登广告，并向我们学生下达指令。
“为什么陈济成在他的广告和对我们学生的指令中都不反对和平运动？难道不是因为他想掩盖其秘密行为吗？
“我们应该成为抗战和建国中的模范战士，否则青年界会将我们视为亲傀儡分子，教育局也不会承认我们的资格。
“不愿做奴隶的私立上海中学三千名学生。”

page_data.en:
August 23, 1939. Afternoon Translation.

Ta Mei Wen Pao (22/8) and Chinese-American Daily News :-

THE SHANGHAI MIDDLE SCHOOL

The Shanghai Middle School (上海中學) on
Chengtu Road off Bubbling Well Road is operated by Chen
Chi-zung (陳濟成). Of late Chen has been accused of
supporting Wang Ching-wei's peace movement. Chen later
issued a notice denying the report.
Unexpectedly, on the morning of August 22,
when the management of the school was holding an examination
of newly registered students, eight persons, having the
appearance of students of the school, entered the office
of the school and assaulted Tseu Tze-tsoh (周汝作), the
Dean.
The movements of these "students" were so quick
that the employees of the school learned of the attack only
after some time had elapsed.

Chinese-American Daily News publishes the following letter
from one Chow Ching-tien (周青天) in connection with
the activities of Chen Chi-zung, President of the Shanghai
Middle School :-

Students' Demands Rejected

Since the publication of a report in the
"North China Daily News" on the activities of Chen Chi-zung,
President of the Shanghai Middle School, in support of
Wang Ching-wei's peace movement, Chen, fearing that the
students might turn against him, thereby causing him to
lose the confidence of his master, has had several meetings
with his followers to discuss measures to deal with the
problem.
On August 19, a number of students were invited
to attend a meeting in support of the school. The presidium
consisted of five persons appointed by the management of
the school.
In the course of the meeting, the students
present were forced to approve the manifesto drawn up by
Chen Chi-zung himself supporting his own case. The
invitation was ignored.
The students later submitted the following
demands to the President:-
(1) That, a telegram be sent to the Chungking
Government pledging determined support to the policy of the
war of resistance and strong opposition to Wang Ching-wei.
(2) That the President make another definite
clarification of his attitude.
(3) That the students be authorized to draft
their own announcement clarifying their attitude and that
this statement be issued for publication in newspapers.
(4) That all the directors and teachers of the
school be requested to make a clarification of the position
of the school.
In rejecting these demands, the President
replied as follows:-
page_data.zh:
1939年8月23日。下午译件。

《大美晚报》（8月22日）及《中美日报》：

上海中学

位于静安寺路成都路的上海中学（上海中學）由陈济成（陳濟成）经办。近来，陈济成被指控支持汪精卫的和平运动。陈随后发布通告否认该报道。
不料，8月22日上午，当该校管理层正在对新生进行入学考试时，八名貌似该校学生的人进入学校办公室，殴打了教务主任周汝作（周汝作）。
这些“学生”行动迅速，以致学校职员在过了一段时间后才得知袭击发生。

《中美日报》刊登了一封来自周青天（周青天）的来信，内容涉及上海中学校长陈济成的活动：

学生要求遭拒

自从《字林西报》刊登关于上海中学校长陈济成支持汪精卫和平运动的报道以来，陈因担心学生可能转而反对他，从而导致他失去其主子的信任，便与其追随者多次开会，商讨应对该问题的措施。
8月19日，校方邀请部分学生参加支持学校的会议。主席团由校方任命的五人组成。
会议期间，与会学生被迫批准由陈济成亲自起草、为其自身辩护的宣言。该邀请被忽视。
学生们随后向校长提交了以下要求：
(1) 向重庆政府发送电报，承诺坚决支持抗战政策，并强烈反对汪精卫。
(2) 校长应再次明确澄清其立场。
(3) 授权学生起草一份澄清其立场的公告，并将该声明送交报纸发表。
(4) 要求全校董事和教师澄清学校的立场。
校长在拒绝这些要求时，答复如下：

page_data.en:
(1) That owing to certain circumstances, the
question of sending a telegram to Chungking cannot be
considered.
(2) That as he (the President) has already
published a denial in the Chinese-American Daily News, it
will do no good if he make a further statement; moreover
this might incur the displeasures of the X authorities
with grave consequences.
(3) That if the students desire to publish
a notice in the newspapers, the draft of such notice should
be prepared by the teachers specially selected by the
President and should be submitted for approval by the
President before it is sent to the newspapers.
(4) That a request to the directors of the
school to make a statement clarifying the position of the
school cannot be allowed owing to certain circumstances,
but if it is desired to invite them to have a talk with
the students, he (the President) would endeavour to arrange
this.
Recently several copies of anti-Wang Ching-wei
and anti-Chen Chi-zung handbills were sent to the school.
Seven of them were thrown into the office of the President
and two in the dining hall. Consequently, Chen became
excited and a number of students were again invited to the
school. On arrival, the students were forced to sign their
names to a piece of paper refuting the open letter addressed
to fellow students and issued in the name of the 3,000
students of the Shanghai Middle School. It was also
decided to issue a refutation against your paper and in
case of necessity, legal proceedings will be undertaken.
All the foregoing facts are true and reliable.
I request that they be published so that the readers will
not be misled by the recent statement of Chen Chi-zung.
page_data.zh:
(1) 由于某些情况，向重庆发送电报一事不予考虑。
(2) 鉴于他（校长）已在《中美日报》上发表否认声明，再作进一步声明无益；此外，这可能会招致X当局的不满，后果严重。
(3) 如果学生希望在报纸上刊登启事，此类启事的草稿应由校长特别选派的教师拟定，并在送交报纸前提交校长批准。
(4) 由于某些情况，不允许要求学校董事发表声明以澄清学校立场，但如果希望邀请他们与学生谈话，他（校长）将尽力安排。
最近，几份反汪精卫和反陈济成的传单被寄到学校。其中七份被扔进校长办公室，两份被扔进食堂。因此，陈变得激动起来，再次邀请一些学生到校。学生到达后，被迫在一张纸上签名，驳斥以上海中学三千名学生名义发给同学们的公开信。还决定对贵报发表驳斥文章，如有必要，将采取法律行动。
以上事实均真实可靠。
我请求予以刊登，以免读者被陈济成最近的声明所误导。

August 24, 1939. Afternoon Translation.

Hwa Pao, Sin Wan Pao, Shun Pao and Chinese-American Daily
News :-

THE AFFAIRS OF THE SHANGHAI MIDDLE SCHOOL

At 11 a.m. August 22, Tseu Tze-tsoh (周作人),
Dean of the Shanghai Middle School (上海中学) of which
Chen Chi-zung (陈济成) is the President, was severely
beaten up in his office by more than ten desperadoes
disguised as students. The assault took place shortly after,
the President had left the school and was witnessed by
several employees of the school.
Upon learning of the assault, the students
became highly indignant, because Tseu, since his appointment
as Dean more than ten years ago, has worked very hard for
students and after the outbreak of hostilities, Tseu led
the students in the national reconstruction movement. He
enjoys the confidence of the students of the school, but
is distrusted by Chen Chi-zung, the President, who,
suspecting Tseu in connection with his exposure by the
3,000 students of the school, resorted to loafer-like
methods to deal with Tseu.
The students have sent a telegram to the
National Government requesting drastic action against him;
they also have decided to fight Chen Chi-zung to the bitter
end so as to eliminate such corrupt elements.
page_data.zh:
1939年8月24日。下午译件。

《华报》、《新闻报》、《申报》及《中美日报》：

上海中学事件

8月22日上午11时，上海中学（上海中学）教务主任周作人（周作人）——该校校长为陈济成（陈济成）——在其办公室内遭到十余名伪装成学生的暴徒毒打。袭击发生在校长离开学校后不久，数名学校职员目睹了此事。
学生们得知袭击消息后极为愤慨，因为周自十多年前担任教务主任以来，一直为学生辛勤工作，且在战事爆发后，周带领学生参与国家重建运动。他深受该校学生信任，但受到校长陈济成的猜忌。陈怀疑周与该校三千名学生对他的揭露有关，遂采取流氓手段对付周。
学生们已向国民政府发出电报，请求对其采取严厉行动；他们还决定与陈济成斗争到底，以清除此类腐败分子。

Chinese-American Daily News :- 6.12.39 (AM)

THE POSITION OF SCHOOLS IN SHANGHAI

Yesterday it was reported that the Education
Department of the Kiangsu Provincial Government had issued
an order instructing all the schools in Shanghai registered
with the department to remove to North Kiangsu. Enquiries
revealed that the Education Department had not issued such
an order. It seems that about a month ago when circum-
stances in Shanghai were very bad and when it could not be
ascertained how long these schools would be able to continue,
the Education Department had instructed these schools to
expedite the lessons so as to be ready to wind up their
affairs in case of emergency.
However, should the oppression of schools
registered with this Education Department endanger their
existence in Shanghai, other suitable means will be devised
to cope with the situation. For the present, there is no
necessity to remove the schools.
page_data.zh:
《中美日报》：1939年12月6日（上午）

上海学校的处境

昨日有报道称，江苏省政府教育厅已发布命令，指示所有在该厅注册的上海学校迁往苏北。经查询，教育厅并未发布此类命令。看来，约一个月前，当上海局势非常恶劣，且无法确定这些学校能维持多久时，教育厅曾指示这些学校加快教学进度，以便在紧急情况下准备结束事务。
然而，如果注册在该教育厅的学校受到压迫，危及其在上海的生存，将制定其他适当措施来应对局势。目前，没有必要迁移学校。

page_data.en:
A. A letter to the teaching staff
in the Kiangsu Province
---------
The province of Kiangsu has long enjoyed
a good name in the field of education. This is
undoubtedly due to the endeavours of all teachers in
this province. Following the outbreak of August 13
hostilities, a number of them have departed for the South-
West with the result that schools had to be closed.
However as the situation has gradually improved, teachers
proceeded to Shanghai and reopened schools under the
protection of the neutrality of the foreign settlements,
with a view to enabling the students to continue their studies
and on the other hand earning a living for themselves.
There have been splendid achievements
both spiritually and materially in the course of the
development of the education scheme of the Kiangsu
Province during the past ten years under the guidance
of Mr. Chow (Fu-hai) but the recent suspension of classes
in this province was the direct result of the current
hostilities for which the national government is to
blame because she fought without first estimating her
own strength.
It appears strange that you, being members
of the intelligentsia, have opposed the "Peace Movement"
which has been sponsored by Mr. Wang Ching Wei and
placed your confidence in foreign assistance.
At the present stage of hostilities, over
ten provinces have been lost and some one million soldiers
killed. The people become poorer and poorer while the
government's finances are exhausted; presenting an
page_data.zh:
A. 致江苏省教职员的一封信
---------
江苏省在教育领域久享盛誉。这无疑归功于本省全体教师的努力。自“八·一三”战事爆发以来，部分教师已随校迁往西南，导致学校被迫关闭。然而，随着局势逐渐好转，教师们来到上海，在外国租界中立的庇护下重新开学，一方面使学生能够继续学业，另一方面也以此谋生。
在过去十年间，江苏省的教育方案在周（佛海）先生的指导下取得了精神与物质方面的卓越成就，但本省近期停课的直接原因乃是当前的战事，对此国民政府难辞其咎，因其未先估量自身实力便贸然作战。
令人诧异的是，你们身为知识界成员，竟反对汪精卫先生所倡导的“和平运动”，转而寄望于外国的援助。
在目前战事阶段，已有十余个省份沦陷，约有一百万士兵阵亡。民众日益贫困，而政府财政已告枯竭；呈现出一种

October 26, 1939. Afternoon Translation.

Chinese-American Daily News publishes the following letter
dated October 20 written by a student of the Kiangsu
Provincial Nan Tung Middle School (江蘇省立南通中學):

THE KIANGSU PROVINCIAL NAN TUNG MIDDLE SCHOOL

It has been rumoured for a long time that Feng
Nyoh-chung (馮樹君), the President of our school, has
turned a traitor. For this reason, he has applied for
leave of absence under the pretext of indisposition from
the Education Department of the Kiangsu Provincial
Government. The affairs of the school have thus been
handled by the Chief Instructor and the Dean appointed by
the Education Department. Later the Chief Instructor
owing to certain private affairs returned on leave to his
native place, with the result that the Dean is alone
responsible for the affairs of the school. However,
owing to the fact that the President had misdirected the
funds of the school it has been in dire financial difficulty.
Moreover a number of the students have formed a "School-
Support Committee," a few of them not knowing the true
facts believe the Dean desires to usurp the position of
President of the school. Consequently, the Dean, as a
proof of his frankness, has left the school. A serious
dispute is now brewing in the school due to the activities
of a small number of members of the "School-Support
Committee" who are inviting the return of the President.
This trouble has become more and more aggravated by reason
of interference by certain teachers of the school, with
the result that other teachers have applied for leave
and left.

As your paper is known for upholding justice,
I therefore write you this letter in the hope that it be
published so as to enable the public to gain some knowledge
of the actual facts of the trouble.

《中美日报》刊登了以下一封日期为10月20日、由江苏省立南通中学学生写的信：

江苏省立南通中学

长期以来有谣言称，我校校长冯树君（馮樹君）已变节投敌。因此，他以身体不适为由向江苏省政府教育厅请假。学校事务遂由教育厅任命的教务主任和训导主任处理。后来，教务主任因私事请假返回原籍，导致训导主任独自负责学校事务。然而，由于校长挪用学校资金，学校陷入严重的财务困境。此外，部分学生成立了“护校委员会”，其中少数人不了解真相，认为训导主任企图篡夺校长职位。因此，训导主任为证明其坦荡，已离开学校。由于“护校委员会”少数成员活动邀请校长返校，校内正酝酿着一场严重纠纷。加之学校某些教师的干涉，事态日益恶化，导致其他教师请假离职。

鉴于贵报以主持正义闻名，故致此信，希望能予刊登，使公众了解纠纷的实际事实。

《中美日报》刊登以下电报：

汪精卫拟组建政府

东京，10月25日。
日本外务省发言人今日发表声明称，截至目前，尚未确定汪精卫领导下的新政权正式成立的日期。发言人否认了汪精卫已与国民政府进行谈判的报道……跨洋通讯社。

《中美日报》，大美报：

青岛，10月25日。
据今日到达此处的消息，北平临时政府和“维新政府”决定于10月28日在此召开各自执行委员会联席会议，届时汪精卫、梁鸿志和王克敏将出席。.. 合众社。

29.10.39(PM)
NOTICE BY TWO EDUCATIONALISTS
Ling Tseng-kung (林震公) and Lieu Tih (刘铁)
publish the following notice in the advertisement
columns of the "Chinese-American Daily News" :-
We have been working with educational circles
for a number of years and have always observed the laws
of the government and obeyed its orders. On the
outbreak of the war of resistance, we complied with the
policy of the National Government and undertook educational
work that is helpful to the war of resistance.
Forced by circumstances, we have now left
Shanghai for Chungking, thereby putting a stop to all
rumours. Lest a misunderstanding should arise, we
hereby publish this notice.
page_data.zh:
1939年10月29日（下午）
两位教育界人士的公告
林震公和刘铁在《中美日报》广告栏刊登以下公告：
我们在教育界工作多年，一直遵守政府法律并服从其命令。抗战爆发后，我们遵从国民政府政策，从事有助于抗战的教育工作。
迫于形势，我们现已离开上海前往重庆，以此止息所有谣言。为避免产生误解，特此发布公告。

SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I, Special Branch. Station,
REPORT
Date October 7, 19 39.
Subject List of schools in the Settlement reported to have underground
political connections with the Wang Ching Wei clique
Made by D.I. Sia Tse-liang Forwarded by

Forwarded herewith is a list of those schools
in the Settlement for the control of which members
of the Wang Ching Wei clique are reported to have been
making serious advances for some time. A number
of the principals or their deputies of these schools
are known to have become members of the Wang Ching Wei
clique. Some of these individuals have for some
years past been close associates of Chow Vai-hai (周佛海),
formerly Commissioner of Education of the Kiangsu
Provincial Government and at present one of the right-
hand men of Wang Ching Wei. According to information
in hand, the remainder have capitulated before monetary
inducements and/or threats of violence, to which members
of the notorious Wang clique would have no hesitation
in giving effect if those whom they approach should
turn down in defiance their demand for surrender. This
desperate determination of Wang's clique has been un-
mistakably demonstrated in the case of Wu Tse-chien
(吳志騫), the late President of the Shanghai Girls'
University, who was assassinated on September 4, 1939,
almost immediately following his publication of an
announcement in the local Chinese press, categorically
denouncing Wang Ching Wei's cause.

Sih Tse hiang
C. D. I
D.C. (Special Branch)

随函附上一份租界内学校名单，据报道，汪精卫集团成员长期以来一直在认真谋求控制这些学校。这些学校的部分校长或其代理人已知已成为汪精卫集团成员。其中一些人多年来一直是前江苏省政府教育厅厅长、现任汪精卫得力助手之一周佛海（周佛海）的亲密伙伴。根据手头掌握的信息，其余的人则在金钱诱惑和/或暴力威胁面前屈服，如果被接触者违抗其投降要求，臭名昭著的汪氏集团成员将毫不犹豫地实施这些威胁。汪氏集团的这种孤注一掷的决心在吴志騫（吳志騫）一案中得到了 unmistakably 的证明，吴志騫是前上海女子大学校长，他在当地中文报刊上发表声明，明确谴责汪精卫的事业后不久，便于1939年9月4日遇刺身亡。

Sih Tse hiang
C. D. I
特别处副处长

CHINA PRESS
SEP 2, 1929

Court Holds
2 Detectives
For Assault

Two Chinese detectives, turned over to the Settlement police on Thursday, yesterday were brought before the First Special District Court accused of assaulting a student of the Shanghai Academy.
The officers did not beat up the student on their own initiative, police said, but were simply taking instructions from another student, Chiu Chen-tse, who is also behind bars.
The incident took place on Tuesday when Chiu and the victim had a petty quarrel in the student dormitory. Angered by the latter's aggressiveness, it was alleged, Chiu called in the detectives to help him in giving the youth a licking.
Realizing the seriousness of the victim's injuries, police said, Chiu called for an ambulance to take his schoolmate to the Paulun Hospital. Attending physicians said the patient was in a critical condition.
Meanwhile, both the detectives and Chiu were held by the court on writs of detention. The detectives gave their names as Wong Pi-ching (CDC 301) and Li Pah-chin (CDC 215).

（批：R.A. 2/9）

《字林西报》（CHINA PRESS）
1929年9月2日

法院羁押
两名侦探
涉嫌殴打

两名华籍侦探于周四移交给租界警方，昨日被提审至第一特区法院，被控殴打上海学院（Shanghai Academy）的一名学生。
警方称，这两名警官并非主动殴打该学生，而是听从另一名学生邱振泽（Chiu Chen-tse，音译）的指令行事，邱目前也被关押。
事件发生在周二，当时邱与受害者在学生宿舍发生 petty quarrel（小争执）。据称，邱因对方的挑衅行为而愤怒，便叫来侦探帮忙教训这名青年。
警方称，邱意识到受害者伤势严重，便叫来救护车将同学送往宝隆医院（Paulun Hospital）。接诊医生表示患者情况危急。
与此同时，两名侦探和邱均被法院凭拘留令羁押。两名侦探自报姓名为黄碧清（Wong Pi-ching，警号CDC 301）和李柏金（Li Pah-chin，警号CDC 215）。

（批注：R.A. 9月2日）

in a position to justify the expenditure of the $10,000 he
was receiving monthly from Chungking.
Everyone knows the low character of Chiang Chien-
pah. He was the first to propose peace and when he
was turned away by members of the peace movement, because
of his low character, he had sought the co-operation of
the communists. He is now using the "Chinese-American
Daily News" as his mouth-piece.
page_data.zh:
1939年9月17日。晨间翻译。

9月16日《华中日报》：

上海市学生协会致学生公开信
揭露一名腐败的教育家

在各校制造所有麻烦的人是蒋建白（Chiang Chien-pah），他是国民政府教育部的特派员，现已变得不忠且亲共。由于无法控制上海的学校，又担心受到其在重庆的主子谴责，他制造了这些麻烦，以便为其每月从重庆领取的10,000美元开支提供正当理由。
众所周知，蒋建白品格低劣。他最先提出和平主张，但因品格低劣被和平运动成员拒绝后，他便寻求与共产党合作。他现在利用《中美日报》作为其喉舌。

page_data.en:
September 15, 1939. Afternoon Translation

Chinese-American Daily News publishes the following two letters:-

THE TUNG NAN PROFESSIONAL MIDDLE SCHOOL

Following the exposure by your paper of the disloyalty of our acting Principal Sung Yao-zai (孙育才), the following notice was posted up in the school on September 11:-
"A telegram has been received from Principal Kuo to the effect that as the acting Principal Sung Yao-zai has on several occasions tendered his resignation, it has now been accepted. Beginning with this term, Liu Boo-tsin (刘步青) will be in charge of all the affairs of the Tung Nan Professional Middle School (东南职业中学)."
This school is attached to the Tung Nan Medical College (东南医学院), of which the President is Kuo Che-yuan (郭济元) who is serving in the army in the interior. Sung Yao-zai is now a traitor. The notice says only that Sung will no longer be the acting Principal; it does not say whether Sung will continue to teach lessons or not.
The students are bitterly criticising Sung. If he should be so bold as to return to the school, it is sure that he will be so beaten up that not a piece of skin will remain whole on his body.
A student of the Tung Nan Professional Middle School.
September 12.

The Pootung Middle School

The students became very angry upon learning through your paper that Hwang Mei-yung (黄美云), Principal of the Pootung Middle School (浦东中学), was co-operating with the puppet organization. We are now devising measures to wipe off that humiliation for the sake of the reputation of the school.
Many important teachers and employees of this school have been bought over with a monthly subsidy of $50 to keep a watch on the students. A number of students have also been bought over and utilized as hirelings to adopt under-hand measures to deal with loyal students. We hope the public will render us assistance.
A section of the students of the Pootung Middle School.
September 12.
page_data.zh:
1939年9月15日。下午翻译

《中美日报》刊登以下两封信：-

东南职业中学

继贵报揭露我校代理校长孙育才（Sung Yao-zai）的不忠行为后，学校于9月11日张贴了如下通告：-
“收到郭校长来电，鉴于代理校长孙育才多次提出辞职，现予接受。从本学期开始，刘步青（Liu Boo-tsin）将负责东南职业中学（Tung Nan Professional Middle School）的一切事务。”
该校附属于东南医学院（Tung Nan Medical College），院长郭济元（Kuo Che-yuan）正在内地服役。孙育才现在是汉奸。通告仅称孙不再担任代理校长；并未说明孙是否继续授课。
学生们对孙进行了严厉批评。如果他胆敢回到学校，肯定会被打得体无完肤。
东南职业中学一名学生。
9月12日。

浦东中学

学生们通过贵报得知浦东中学（Pootung Middle School）校长黄美云（Hwang Mei-yung）与伪组织合作后，非常愤怒。为了学校的声誉，我们正在策划措施以洗刷这一耻辱。
该校许多重要教师和职员已被每月50美元的津贴收买，以监视学生。还有一些学生也被收买，被用作爪牙，采取卑鄙手段对付爱国学生。我们希望公众给予我们援助。
浦东中学部分学生。
9月12日。

page_data.en:
Chinese-American Daily News publishes the following letter
from one Yang Wei-ying:- 14.9.39 (PM)

Yang Wei-ying's Refutation

On September 11, your paper reported that
Yang Wei-ying (楊蔚蔭) had been appointed director
of the Wu Poh and Min Kuo Middle and Primary Schools.
I was a director of the Wu Poh Middle and
Primary School (沪北中小学) long before the January 28
Incident when the school was located in Chapei. At
that time Tsiang Hwei-soo (姜怀素) and Wang Shiao-lan
(王曉籟) were also directors of the school. I did
nothing for the school but solicited some $600 for the
purchase of books.

After the outbreak of the August 13 Incident,
I did not know to what place the school had removed. I
have never been informed that the Board of Directors of
the Wu Poh Middle and Primary School and the Min Kuo
Middle and Primary School (民國中小学) had been
reorganized and that I have been appointed as a director.
I have been in Shanghai over 10 years and am
now old and infirm. Recently Messrs. Yu Li-tung
(袁履登) and Wen Lan-ding (周蘭亭) invited me to be
a director of the Refugee Children Training Institute.
I rendered some assistance. My life has been an idle
one with several rounds of mahjong and a game of Chinese
chess. All this is true.
page_data.zh:
《中美日报》刊登杨蔚荫（Yang Wei-ying）的以下来信：- 1939年9月14日（下午）

杨蔚荫的辩驳

9月11日，贵报报道杨蔚荫（楊蔚蔭）被任命为沪北中小学和民国中小学的董事。
早在“一·二八”事变之前，当学校位于闸北时，我就已是沪北中小学（Wu Poh Middle and Primary School）的董事。当时姜怀素（Tsiang Hwei-soo）和王晓籁（Wang Shiao-lan）也是该校董事。我为学校所做的工作仅为募集约600美元用于购书。

“八·一三”事变爆发后，我不知道学校迁往何处。我从未接到通知说沪北中小学和民国中小学（Min Kuo Middle and Primary School）的董事会已改组，也未被告知我被任命为董事。
我在上海已居住十多年，如今年老体弱。最近，袁履登（Yu Li-tung，注：拼音Yu对应袁，但常见拼写为Yuan，此处依汉字译出）和周兰亭（Wen Lan-ding，注：拼音Wen对应周，但常见拼写为Zhou，此处依汉字译出）先生邀请我担任难民儿童训练所董事。我提供了一些协助。我的生活一直很闲散，打几圈麻将，下几盘中国象棋。以上均为事实。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL

June 21, 1940. Morning Translation.

To Mei Pao :-

LETTER TO THE EDITOR FROM COMMITTEE OF REPRESENTATIVES OF
THE 17 CLASSES OF THE SHANGHAI MIDDLE SCHOOL ESTABLISHED
BY THE KIANGSU PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT

The report published in your newspaper about
our school and about the demands of the students is untrue.
We hereby give you the correct demands of the
students :-
(1) The school will give a written guarantee that no patriotic
students will be dismissed.
(2) The school will give a written guarantee that no
reorganization or surrender of the school will be made.
(3) The fundamental freedom of the students, such as the
holding of class meetings and the issuing of magazines,
will be supported by the school.
(4) Classes will remain open during the summer vacation.
(5) The Federation of students of all classes will be restored.
(6) Examination papers of graduates of the class of Junior
Middle III will be made public so that no patriotic
students may be dismissed under this pretext.
(7) Representatives of students will be allowed to participate
in school affairs meetings so that the finances and
the affairs of the school may be made public.
(8) Students who are known to be traitors will be dismissed.
We hope that a correction will be published
in your newspaper.

1940年6月21日。晨间翻译。

致梅宝（Mei Pao，音译，可能指某报社或编辑）：-

江苏省立上海中学十七个班级代表委员会致编辑的信

贵报刊登的关于我校及学生要求的报道不实。
特此告知学生的正确要求如下：-
(1) 学校须出具书面保证，不开除任何爱国学生。
(2) 学校须出具书面保证，不进行改组或投降。
(3) 学生的基本自由，如举行班会和出版刊物，将得到学校的支持。
(4) 暑假期间课程将继续开放。
(5) 恢复各班学生联合会。
(6) 公布初中三年级毕业生的试卷，以免以此为借口开除爱国学生。
(7) 允许学生代表参加校务会议，以便公开学校财务和事务。
(8) 开除已知的汉奸学生。
我们希望贵报刊登更正声明。

page_data.en:
February 7, 1940.
Afternoon Translation.

National Herald :-

LOCAL SCHOOLS TO REMAIN OPEN ON SPRING FESTIVAL

Recently, local schools received a notice
from "The Shanghai Educational Circles Federation", stating
that all schools will have a three days' holiday at the
Spring Festival.
According to an investigation made, there is
no legal educational body in Shanghai known by the name of
"The Shanghai Educational Circles Federation". It is
clear that undesirables are using this name to mislead the
public for local schools will remain open as usual during
the Spring Festival.

9 2 40
Jm
page_data.zh:
1940年2月7日。
下午翻译。

《国民新闻》（National Herald）：-

本地学校春节照常上课

近日，本地学校收到“上海教育界联合会”的通知，称所有学校在春节放假三天。
经调查，上海并无名为“上海教育界联合会”的合法教育机构。显然，是不法分子利用此名称误导公众，因为本地学校在春节期间将照常上课。

9 2 40
Jm

page_data.en:
May 20, 1940. Morning Translation.

National Herald :-

TROUBLE IN THE SHANGHAI MIDDLE SCHOOL .

After the defection of Chen Chi-zung in autumn last year, serious trouble occurred in the Shanghai Middle School and this resulted in Chen retiring from the post of Principal of this school and of its three affiliated organs, namely, the Shanghai Primary School, the Shanghai Normal School and the Shanghai Kindergarten, while Messrs. Yu Ya-ching, Ling Kong-hou, Wen Lai-ting and L.T. Yuan, Chairmen of the Boards of Directors of these schools, were appointed concurrently as Principals of these four schools.

After the formal inauguration of the puppet government of Wang Ching-wei in Nanking and his assumption of office, Chen appointed many of his trusted men, at present teaching in the Shanghai Middle School, to posts in the Nanking Government under false names. They are not required to attend office but are given high pay monthly; in the meantime they can still carry on their teaching.

When the students of these schools, including the entire body of students of the first and second grade in the senior middle school of the south branch at the corner of Bubbling Well and Chengtu Roads, learnt of this state of affairs, they went on strike and demanded that every member of the teaching staff clarify his stand; they also declared that they have no wish to study in a school which is actually the private property of Chen Chi-zung. Upon learning of the trouble, the new Principals advised the students to resume their studies and at the same time they issued a statement completely denying the allegation that the schools belongs to a private individual.

It is learned that as a result of this action, the students have agreed to resume studies to-day but they are said to be still devising adequate ways and means to deal with those teachers who are holding positions with the puppet government.
page_data.zh:
1940年5月20日。晨间译件。

《国民新闻报》：

上海中学发生风波。

自去年秋季陈纪恂叛变后，上海中学发生严重风波，导致陈辞去该校及其三个附属机构（即上海小学、上海师范学校和上海幼稚园）的校长职务，而上述各校的董事会主席俞亚清、凌孔侯、文莱廷和袁良田（L.T. Yuan，音译）先生被兼任这四所学校的校长。

汪精卫在南京的伪政府正式成立并就职后，陈任命了许多其亲信担任南京政府的职位，这些人目前仍在上海中学任教，但使用化名。他们无需到职办公，但每月领取高薪；与此同时，他们仍可继续从事教学工作。

当这些学校的学生，包括位于静安寺路与成都路拐角处南校高中一、二年级全体学生，得知这一情况后，他们举行罢工，要求全体教职员工表明立场；他们还声明，不愿在实际上是陈纪恂私产的學校中求学。新任校长们得知风波后，劝告学生复课，同时发表声明，完全否认学校属于个人的指控。

据悉，由于此举，学生们已同意今日复课，但据说他们仍在策划适当的方式和方法，以对付那些在伪政府任职的教师。

page_data.en:
May 20, 1940.
Morning Translation.

Chinese-American Daily News (Comment) :-

The clear understanding of educational matters
on the part of the Chairmen of the Boards of Directors and
Principals of the Shanghai Middle School, the Shanghai
Primary School, the Shanghai Normal School and the Shanghai
Kindergarten and the impartial attitude adopted by them as
revealed in their notice appearing in the local Press
yesterday deserves the highest commendation and respect
from the public.
Although we are still ignorant of the object
of the publication of this notice, we are confident that
the four Principals will continue to maintain in a
responsible manner the administration of these four schools.
page_data.zh:
1940年5月20日。
晨间译件。

《中美日报》（评论）：

上海中学、上海小学、上海师范学校和上海幼稚园的董事会主席及校长们对教育事务有着清晰的认识，他们在昨日本地报刊上刊登的公告中所表现出的公正态度，值得公众给予最高的赞扬和尊重。
虽然我们尚不清楚发布此公告的目的，但我们相信，这四位校长将继续以负责任的态度维持这四所学校的管理工作。

May 24, 1940. Morning Translation

Chinese-American Daily News publishes the following article:-

DISAFFECTED EDUCATIONALISTS

During the period when Liang Hung-tse was President of the Executive Yuan of the "Reformed Government," Zee Yung-chu (徐玉), a member of the educational circles in Shanghai, was the first to betray his conscience and work in the interests of his "masters." He directed his activities particularly against those schools established by provincial governments. The methods employed by him were cunning and cruel in the extreme and he made every effort, until it succeeded, in bringing about the disaffection of educationalists of standing. As a result, a number of "cold-blooded" educationalists became disaffected and blinded to their proper interests.

The following is a list of disaffected educationalists :-
(1) Zien Wei-tsong (錢慰宗), formerly Chief of the Education Department of the Futan University and principal of the Kuo Kwang Middle School (國光中學). He is now a Senior Departmental Chief of the Ministry of Education of the puppet regime and concurrently Secretary to the Preparatory Committee for the restoration of the puppet Central University.

The disaffection of Zien Wei-tsong is not unexpected, because almost everything he did in his life was mean and shameless. After his graduation from Columbia University in U.S.A., he returned to China and, determined to recover the money he had spent for his education, he founded the Kuo Kwang Middle School. The majority of the important officials of this school were members of his clan and for some time the school was better known as "Zien's Family Chapel." Subsequently, he entered the Futan University and obtained the post of Chief of the Education Department of the university, this following the departure of Mr. Chen Li-kiang (陳立江), the former head, for Chungking. Due to the fact that he had won the favour of a certain prominent person, he was elected last year as a member of the S.M.C. Library Committee.

Prior to his revocation of allegiance, his relatives and friends gave him advice to which he paid no attention. This clearly indicates his slavish nature. Recently, he issued an open letter addressed to the students of the Education Department of the Futan University, in which he vilified our supreme leader, General Chiang Kai-shek. Readers, think over it! Are these the words of a man?

(2) Chen Che-chen (陈济成), formerly principal of the privately-established Shanghai Middle School and at present a member of the Standing Committee of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Commission of the puppet regime.

Chen has always regarded the school as a sort of a shop and used the "blood and sweat" of the family heads of the students for his personal enjoyment. Some time ago he had a wonderful idea whereby he formed "Four Schools General Office" on the lines of a general sales office in

1940年5月24日。晨间译件

《中美日报》刊登以下文章：

变节的教育界人士

在梁鸿哲担任“维新政府”行政院院长期间，上海教育界人士徐玉（Zee Yung-chu，音译）率先丧失良心，为其“主子”的利益效力。他的活动特别针对由省政府建立的学校。他所采用的手段极其狡猾和残酷，他不遗余力地促使有地位的教育界人士变节，直至成功。结果，一些“冷血”的教育界人士变节，并忽视了他们的正当利益。

以下是变节的教育界人士名单：
(1) 钱慰宗（Zien Wei-tsong，音译），前复旦大学教育学院主任及国光中学校长。他现在是伪政权教育部的高级处长，并兼任伪中央大学恢复筹备委员会秘书。

钱慰宗的变节并不出人意料，因为他一生中几乎所有的行为都卑鄙无耻。从美国哥伦比亚大学毕业后，他回到中国，决心收回他在教育上花费的钱，于是创办了国光中学。该校大多数重要官员都是他的家族成员，因此在一段时间内，该校更被称为“钱氏家祠”。随后，他进入复旦大学，并在前任主任陈立江（Chen Li-kiang，音译）前往重庆后，获得了该大学教育学院主任的职位。由于他赢得了一位知名人物的青睐，他于去年当选为工部局图书馆委员会委员。

在他背叛之前，亲友曾给他建议，但他置之不理。这清楚地表明了他的奴性。最近，他发表了一封致复旦大学教育学院学生的公开信，在其中诋毁我们的最高领袖蒋介石将军。读者们，想一想！这是人说的话吗？

(2) 陈济成（Chen Che-chen，音译），前私立上海中学校长，现为伪政权华侨事务委员会常务委员。

陈一直将学校视为一种商店，利用学生家长的“血汗钱”供个人享乐。不久前，他有一个奇妙的想法，仿照商业公司的总销售办事处模式，成立了“四校总办事处”，

page_data.en:
May 24, 1940.
Morning Translation

business concerns. Through his consumate flattery, he rose
to the rank of a prominent person and made a fortune from
charity. However, as he held no official rank, he changed
his allegiance.
(3) Chang Tsong-wei (張仲寰), formerly
principal of the Sin Wen Vocational School (新文職業學校) and
secretary to the Shanghai Middle School established by the
provincial government. The nature of his present office

Together with his elder brother named Chang

(4) Zee Soo-tseng (徐苏中) was formerly

is at present a senior official attached to the puppet
National Government.
After his disaffection, Zee published in the

(5) Chang Ih-sung (張一聲), formerly of the

(6) Koo Chi-wu (顧繼武), formerly of the

of the Social Affairs Bureau of the former Shanghai City

page_data.zh:
1940年5月24日。
晨间译件

通过他极致的阿谀奉承，他跻身于显贵之列，并从慈善事业中发了财。然而，由于他没有官阶，他改变了效忠对象。
(3) 张仲寰（Chang Tsong-wei，音译），前新文职业学校校长及省政府设立的上海中学秘书。他在伪政权中目前的职务性质不详。

张仲寰与其兄张辛伯（Chang Sin-pah，音译）共同出资建立了一所名为“新文”的职业学校。由于生意清淡，他作为上海中学的秘书，诱使那些未能通过上海中学入学考试的学生进入新文职业学校。
(4) 徐苏中（Zee Soo-tseng，音译），前江西职业学校校长，现为伪国民政府高级官员。

变节后，徐在汪精卫派系的喉舌《华中日报》上发表了一封致江西职业学校学生的公开信。在这篇荒谬的文章中，他对我们的领袖进行了诽谤性攻击，其言辞如同野兽的嚎叫。
(5) 张一声（Chang Ih-sung，音译），前侨光中学人员。
(6) 顾继武（Koo Chi-wu，音译），前青年中学人员。
(7) 张咏春（Chang Yung-tshung，音译），前上海市政府社会局雇员。

February 28, 1942.
Morning Translation.

National Herald :-

NEW HEADMASTER FOR SOOCHOW NORMAL SCHOOL FOR GIRLS

After its removal to Shanghai, Yang Tsung-yui
(楊宗禹) was in charge of the Soochow Normal School for
Girls, established by the Kiangsu Provincial Government.
Afterwards it was discovered that Yang inclined to the side
of the traitors and he was dismissed. The responsibility
for school affairs then went to Chow Yin-yen (周允言).
News from Northern Kiangsu now reveals that Chin Chung-hwa
(金宗華), Commissioner of the Educational Department of
the Kiangsu Provincial Government, has selected Wu Tsung-chia
(吳增嘉), Proctor of the school, to be Acting Headmaster
and that an order to that effect will arrive here soon.
It is learned that Wu Tsung-chia, B.A. of the
Central University, has been a teacher of the Soochow Normal
School for Girls for many years, and prior to the Sino-
Japanese hostilities was chief of the primary section of
that school.

1942年2月28日。
晨间译件。

《国民新闻报》：

苏州女子师范学校新校长

江苏省政府设立的苏州女子师范学校迁至上海后，由杨宗禹（Yang Tsung-yui，音译）负责。后来发现杨倾向于投敌一方，遂将其免职。校务责任随后移交给周允言（Chow Yin-yen，音译）。
来自苏北的消息显示，江苏省政府教育厅厅长金宗华（Chin Chung-hwa，音译）已选定该校监学吴增嘉（Wu Tsung-chia，音译）为代理校长，相关命令即将抵达此处。
据悉，吴增嘉拥有中央大学文学士学位，已在苏州女子师范学校任教多年，在中日敌对行动开始前，曾任该校初等部主任。

Hwa Pao, National Herald :-

LOCAL CHINESE ADVISED TO REMAIN LOYAL

In reply to a telegram which they sent on
New Year Day expressing their regards, the local education
and cultural bodies have received a telegram from Mr.Chen
Lih-fu, Minister of Education of the National Government,
urging them to redouble their efforts to keep up the spirit
of the Chinese people and to remain loyal.

Summary of the past activities of Chen Chi-zung 


Chen Chi-zung ( i Bh ), principal of the 
Shanghai Private Middle Schocl, 460 Chengtu Road, who is 
residing at No.3/179 Connanght Road, was born in 1894 at 
Kading, Kiangsu, and is a graduate of the Lungmen Normal 
Schoo. - Nantao. After graduation, he obtained employment 
in the Shanghai Cotton and Cotton Yarn Exchange, Avenue 
Edward VII, as assistant Chief of the Business Section of 
the General Affairs Department, and consequently met 
Mr. Wen Lai Ding aa ja] & ), prominent local business man, 
who was the chairman of the Board of Dirsactors of the, 
Shanghai Cotton and Cotton Yarn Exchange. It is reported 
that he is now one of Wen's followers. 

In 1924, Chen Chi-zung, with financial assistance 
from Wen Lai Ding, established the Shanghai Primary chow 
en Li Yuan Road, Nantao, and later established three more 
primary schools under the same title at 1297 Robison Road, 
No.2 Tsih Woo Fang, Rue de l*Quest, and 400 Foochow Road. 
In 1927 he established the "Shanghai Private Middle §chool® 


in Pan's Garden, corner of Kinchow and Pingliang Roads and 


also a kindergarten in the Kong Fong Li Alleyway (ff 5 E - 


Connaught Road. Shortly after the outbreak of the local 
hostilities in August, 1937, he had all his schools removed 
to their present address, 460 Chengtu Road, where he 
conducts an elementary normal school, a middle school, a 
primary school, and a kindergarten with a totel of more than 
4,000 students.
